nodes.question: What does Target 11.6 aim to reduce by 2030?
nodes.answer: Target 11.6 aims to reduce the adverse per capita environmental impact of cities, specifically focusing on air quality and waste management.
nodes.paragraph: Target 11.6: By 2030, reduce the adverse per capita environmental impact of cities, including by paying special attention to air quality and municipal and other waste management. 2 Proper waste management contributes to SDG 12 substantially reduce waste generation, ensuring that there is sustainable consump- tion and production patterns. Target 12.5: By 2030, substantially reduce waste generation through prevention, reduction, recycling and reuse. 59 Socio-Ecological Practice Research (2025) 7:57 76 for agriculture, and threaten the livelihoods of communities that depend on natural resources. Focusing on households generates place-based solutions that are relevant and practi- cal for the local community, making them easier to adopt than externally generated solutions. This approach also con- tributes to strategies for achieving SDGs 11 and 12. We are mindful that industries contribute seventy times more waste than households (Rogers 2005 , p. 4). However, we argue that individuals in households who consume industry goods, are the drivers of high waste generation in industries. shows how households and industries create a positive feed- back loop. The demand for industry goods is influenced by self- serving model of capitalist industries that make products with built-in obsolescence and the promotion of frenetic consumer culture (Rogers 2006, p. 219 of 558).
